intent: The clipping box inside the menu's shared popup that holds the open item's content.
typical_uses: Rendered once by NavigationMenu itself, inside the shared popup; never placed by the caller in the ordinary composition

instead.note: The root renders the viewport itself.

invariants.text: navigation-menu.module.css fills the popup with the viewport and hides its overflow, so a content wider or taller than the popup's current size is clipped while the popup resizes to it.

render.states: render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies
render.because: Base UI's render prop takes an element or a function of the viewport's own state, so its type is a union of a React element and a callback - the compiler emits one JSON type per property; the primitive passes an empty state object.

style.states: style accepts a function as well as a plain style object; the primitive passes that function an empty state object
style.because: Base UI widens React's `CSSProperties` to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)`, and the viewport's state carries no fields. The compiler emits one JSON type per property, so nothing is asserted; the kit's own styling goes through navigation-menu.module.css, not through this.

good.title: The ordinary composition, where the root renders the viewport

bad.title: A viewport placed by hand beside the list
bad.why: The root already renders the one viewport the kit composes, inside its shared popup; a second one placed beside the list sits outside that popup, so nothing positions, sizes or clips it.
